objective: Route each manifest through a stable foundation CI gate, exact-head GitHub evidence, bounded failure handling, and an independent read-only reviewer before durable supervision can succeed.
acceptanceCriteria: A stable Autonomous Engineering Foundation check runs on every pull request, performs the focused AI/operations gates only when relevant, and never disappears behind a path filter when configured as a required main check.
GitHub evidence is bound to the exact open draft pull request, branch, base and head SHA; missing, duplicate, stale, skipped, cancelled or unknown required checks cannot be treated as success.
Required check results are normalized into pending, passed, bounded transient rerun, repair-required or blocked outcomes; no failure is hidden, relabelled or bypassed.
An actionable CI failure can allocate only one bounded same-lane coding-worker repair attempt, while a transient workflow rerun is exact, recorded and limited to one per head SHA.
After exact-head CI passes, one named read-only code reviewer receives a deterministic evidence packet and its native task identity is revision-fenced independently from the coding worker.
Durable supervision succeeds only after a strict reviewer report approves every acceptance criterion with no blocking finding and reports no mutation, merge or production effect.

The GitHub App remains unable to merge or bypass protected main, and the hosted main policy blocks deletion and direct pushes while allowing only the Sanctuary human owner to complete a pull-request merge.
stopConditions: The pull request, base, head, required check, workflow run, reviewer identity, evidence hash or durable flow revision does not match exactly.
A CI or reviewer retry would exceed its one-rerun rule or the manifest attempt, time or cost limits.
A required check is missing, skipped, neutral, cancelled, stale, duplicated or unknown and cannot be safely classified from exact GitHub evidence.
Implementation would grant merge, deployment, production, customer-contact, unrestricted GitHub Actions or protected-branch bypass authority to OpenClaw, Codex or the GitHub App.
